svg.title: Four-Panel Quantitative Biophysical and Cultural Ratchet Data Infographic (CA-M1 to CA-M5)
svg.desc: Pre-registered deterministic simulation outputs (seed 20261123): Panel A shows CA-M1 Hill cooperativity curves (n=1,2,4) and noise false-firing reduction (51.9% to 17.8% to 4.5%); Panel B shows CA-M2 SepJ pore closure survival curve and CA-M3 64x flock expansion cohesion; Panel C shows CA-M4 16-node Physarum tube pruning (30 to 20 tubes, TL/MST=1.39, FT=1.00); Panel D shows CA-M5 20-generation cultural retention trajectories after synthetic demonstrators exit at Generation 5.
svg.text: Cross-Species Biophysical & Cultural Ratchet Suite (CA-M1 to CA-M5)

Superlinear feedback dD/dt = |Q|^mu/(1+|Q|^mu) - D prunes 30 -> 20 tubes

D · CA-M5: 20-Generation Cultural Retention After Machine Exit
30 lineages x N=32 agents · 4 synthetic demonstrators removed at Gen 5
